full_page.content:
Page 257 Cont.
Jan. 26 Richard Lukaszewski - 11 - operation tumer on brain - can. - 4 hours on table unconscious 9 hours .... fear .... all in vain
Harold Novak - Family difficulties drinking etc. Victor C. Moore - 53 - serious gall and liver trouble. & itch. George F. Rieden - 48 - ailing-cancer feared
Page 258
Jan. 27 Eugene Redmann - 9 - heart - five weeks on back - carried in last week and Enrolled in Ser. Masses; decidedly improved since but still far from being well ..
Shirley Wessel - 14 - inward cancer - has no appetite, no controll of intestines, etc. Andrew Lekawa - 53 - inner goitre - Cancer of throat feared ....
29 Frank Novack - 40 - has wife and four sons, recently, in fact for a few years has been careless in going to Confession & Holy Communion. Now wants wife to divorce him. Enrolled To-day
Gloria Molinaro - 15 - acute inflamitory rhumatisme
29 Francis Horton - about 40 - full of cancer ..... reported this a.m. as dead .... hopes for cure abandoned .....
Mrs. Julia Prekob - 53 - "dying" in Woman's Hospital".
Page 259
Feb. 1 Patricia 4 - dislocated hips at birth - never just right in walking 151 East Greendale Phone To - 9-1071 - Detroit
Mary Scars - 35 - very severe stomach ache for two yrs. Nothing seems to help, was enrolled.
Feb. 3rd Frank Horton - 41 - supposed to be dying of throat-cancer .... brought to marine hospital Jan. 25th and given 72 hours to live. - fever 106 ..
Stanley Zolkowski - 11 - has been deaf since birth - wants to hear that he may be able to learn about God and receive Holy Communion.
